plain: A 1968 paper by the American aircraft maker Northrop on using electric charge to help planes fly is said to have later vanished from an aeronautics journal, and the idea is said to live on in the wings of the B-2 stealth bomber. Michels tells this from the work of the writer Nick Cook and his book The Hunt for Zero Point, saying a researcher named Dan Marcas went looking for the paper and "found that it had totally vanished." Cook himself, on the show, recalls such papers but places them in the early 1960s and is unsure of the date, linking them to the electric-propulsion work of a scientist named Thomas Townsend Brown.
